name: My Vampire Girlfriend: Romance You Choose
source:
Surrounding your ordinary student life is an urban legend on vampire infestation, recently causing a disturbance to the world.
It may be a completely unfounded rumor worth ignoring, but there has been a series of mysterious events taking place around you.
You and the beautiful girls from your school are dragged into it, and the situation takes an unexpected turn…
What is the truth behind the vampire legend? And which direction will your love go…?
